commands.name: state
commands.summary: Runtime-only presentation state envelope (spirectl.state/v0); state actions returns the native semantic action list.

commands.name: state watch
commands.summary: Read-only NDJSON stream over the state envelope; uses reactive live bridge watch when available and polling fallback otherwise.

examples: sts2 act play-card --card c_17 --target e_2 --player-id p2
commands.name: act play-card
commands.summary: Semantic card play routed through the bridge contract.

commands.name: act use-potion
commands.summary: Use an executable combat potion by stable potion id, with an optional target id when required.

commands.name: act choose
commands.summary: Fallback-only compatibility choice execution for generic, modded, or unmodeled visible choices when no modeled intent action exists.

commands.name: act confirm-selection
commands.summary: Confirm the currently staged selection on a supported selection overlay.

commands.name: act cancel-selection
commands.summary: Cancel the currently staged selection on a supported selection overlay.

commands.name: act mouse click
commands.summary: Dangerous raw viewport mouse click fallback routed through the bridge contract.

commands.name: act select-map-node
commands.summary: Select an executable map node by stable node id.

commands.name: act end-turn
commands.summary: Semantic end-turn execution routed through the bridge contract.

commands.name: act ready
commands.summary: Mark the local multiplayer lobby player ready when the live lobby allows it.

commands.name: act unready
commands.summary: Clear the local multiplayer lobby ready state when the live lobby allows it.

commands.name: act select-character
commands.summary: Select an executable multiplayer lobby character by stable character id in start-run or load-run lobbies.

commands.name: act claim-reward
commands.summary: Claim a visible reward by stable reward id.

commands.name: act skip-rewards
commands.summary: Skip a visible rewards flow when legal.

commands.name: act select-card
commands.summary: Select a visible card in a supported card-selection flow.

commands.name: act skip-card-selection
commands.summary: Skip a skippable card-selection flow.

commands.name: act select-bundle
commands.summary: Select a visible bundle by stable bundle id.

commands.name: act buy-card
commands.summary: Buy a visible shop card by stable shop item id.

commands.name: act buy-relic
commands.summary: Buy a visible shop relic by stable shop item id.

commands.name: act buy-potion
commands.summary: Buy a visible shop potion by stable shop item id.

commands.name: act remove-card
commands.summary: Use a visible shop card-removal service by stable shop item id.

commands.name: act leave-shop
commands.summary: Leave a visible shop when legal.

commands.name: act close-shop-inventory
commands.summary: Close a visible Fake Merchant shop inventory.

commands.name: act rest
commands.summary: Use the visible rest option at a rest site.

commands.name: act smith
commands.summary: Use the visible smith option at a rest site.

commands.name: act use-rest-site-option
commands.summary: Use another visible rest-site option by stable option id.

commands.name: act proceed-rest-site
commands.summary: Proceed from a rest site when visible.

commands.name: act open-chest
commands.summary: Open a visible treasure-room chest.

commands.name: act take-relic
commands.summary: Take a visible relic by stable relic id.

commands.name: act proceed-treasure-room
commands.summary: Proceed from a treasure room when visible.

commands.name: act back-from-map
commands.summary: Go back from the map when visible.

commands.name: act select-event-option
commands.summary: Select a visible first-party event option by stable option id.

commands.name: act open-event-shop
commands.summary: Open a visible event shop entry point such as Fake Merchant.

commands.name: act use-crystal-sphere-control
commands.summary: Use a visible Crystal Sphere control by stable control id.

commands.name: act proceed-event
commands.summary: Proceed from an event when visible.

commands.name: act toggle-map
commands.summary: Toggle the run top-bar map.

commands.name: act toggle-deck
commands.summary: Toggle the run top-bar deck view.

commands.name: act inspect-relic
commands.summary: Open the relic-details overlay for a relic-bar relic.

commands.name: act close-inspect-relic
commands.summary: Close the open relic-details overlay.

commands.name: act select-hand-card
commands.summary: Stage a hand card while in-hand selection mode is active (state.run.view.handSelection).

commands.name: act deselect-hand-card
commands.summary: Unstage a previously selected hand card from the active in-hand selection.

commands.name: act confirm-hand-selection
commands.summary: Confirm the staged in-hand selection; resolves the awaiting card effect (e.g. Survivor's discard).

commands.name: act toggle-settings
commands.summary: Toggle the run top-bar settings menu.

commands.name: act sort-deck-view
commands.summary: Sort the current run deck view.

commands.name: act toggle-deck-view-upgrades
commands.summary: Toggle deck view upgrade previews.

commands.name: dev logs
commands.summary: Read recent structured bridge logs, tail a recent window, or follow new entries through the typed transport client.

commands.name: dev console
commands.summary: Execute an explicit mode-gated STS2 in-game developer console command through the live bridge.

commands.name: dev heal
commands.summary: Instantly heal (or revive) any creature host-side through the game's heal command — a devtool rescue, not a legal player action. Host-direct mutation can desync real remote network clients; fine for couch co-op's single real player.

commands.name: dev log-health
commands.summary: Fail when the recent runtime log window contains unhealthy error or exception-shaped entries after optional exclusions.

commands.name: dev diagnostics
commands.summary: Collect one stable runtime diagnostics payload and optionally write a predictable evidence bundle.

commands.name: dev mod-reload
commands.summary: Build and request reload for an M57/M60 shell-supported hot-reload project through the live bridge.

commands.name: dev mod-reload status
commands.summary: Report active shell protocol, generation, last reload report, and restart-required state for a hot-reload project.

examples: sts2 --json dev http --url http://127.0.0.1:3000/health --query json.status --equals ok
commands.name: dev http
commands.summary: Run one bounded HTTP probe with optional status, header, and JSON/text query assertions.

examples: sts2 --json dev http-wait --url http://127.0.0.1:3000/health --query json.status --equals ok --interval-ms 250
commands.name: dev http-wait
commands.summary: Poll one HTTP endpoint until the requested status, header, or JSON/text query assertions match.

examples: sts2 --json dev fetch --source http://127.0.0.1:3000/build.json --output ./.sts2/artifacts/build.json --query json.status --equals ok
commands.name: dev fetch
commands.summary: Fetch one local or HTTP artifact, optionally write it to disk, and assert over parsed JSON/text content.

examples: sts2 --json dev websocket --url ws://127.0.0.1:3001/events --send-text ping --expect-text pong
commands.name: dev websocket
commands.summary: Open one bounded websocket validation session with optional text sends and expected text frames.

commands.name: dev wait-for
commands.summary: Poll bridge-backed state until a simple path assertion succeeds. `--source actions` polls the resolved `state actions` document instead of the plain state snapshot.

commands.name: dev wait-for-transitions
commands.summary: Poll live runtime transition diagnostics until finite transitions and animations settle.

examples: sts2 --json dev assert actions[label*=Turn].id --source actions --equals action:combat-room:end-turn
commands.name: dev assert
commands.summary: Assert a simple path against the current bridge-backed state. `--source actions` queries the resolved `state actions` document (`spirectl.state-actions/v0`) instead of the plain state snapshot.

commands.name: dev fixture record
commands.summary: Record the current screen-entry fixture recipe into ignored local .sts2/fixtures/current-screen storage without claiming exact mid-screen replay.

commands.name: dev fixture resume
commands.summary: Resume the ignored local recorded screen-entry fixture through recipe-backed fixture loading, optionally restarting first.

commands.name: dev fixture status
commands.summary: Show whether an ignored local recorded screen fixture exists and what screen it targets.

commands.name: dev fixture clear
commands.summary: Clear the ignored local recorded screen fixture.

commands.name: dev fixture load
commands.summary: Load an authored sparse recipe fixture into the attached live bridge and report recipeReport/bridgeValidation diagnostics.

commands.name: dev fixture load-latest
commands.summary: Reload the fixture last loaded in this worktree (recorded under .sts2/fixtures/last-loaded.json), optionally restarting first; designed for per-worktree foreach replays.

commands.name: dev scenario export
commands.summary: Export the attached state as a shareable sparse spirectl.scenario/v0 YAML artifact with field-level restoreSupport and optional exact sidecar metadata.

commands.name: dev scenario load
commands.summary: Load a shareable spirectl.scenario/v0 YAML artifact through the live bridge, with field-level restore validation and degraded multiplayer reporting.

commands.name: dev debug status
commands.summary: Inspect explicit dev-only debug status, leased-session ownership, breakpoint registry, and hook support.

examples: sts2 --json dev debug session start --name smoke-investigation --pause
sts2 --json dev debug session start --role observer --name transcript-watcher
commands.name: dev debug session start
commands.summary: Start an explicit debugger session as the controller lease owner or as a passive observer.

examples: sts2 --json dev debug session status --id dbg:1
commands.name: dev debug session status
commands.summary: Inspect one leased debugger session by stable id.

examples: sts2 --json dev debug session end --id dbg:1 --resume
commands.name: dev debug session end
commands.summary: Release a leased debugger session and optionally resume the runtime.

commands.name: dev debug pause
commands.summary: Request a manual pause through the bridge-owned debug control surface.

commands.name: dev debug resume
commands.summary: Request a resume through the bridge-owned debug control surface.

examples: sts2 --json dev debug step --session dbg:1 --kind action --count 1
commands.name: dev debug step
commands.summary: Request a bounded frame/action step through the explicit debug surface.

commands.name: dev debug events
commands.summary: Replay bounded debugger events by sequence cursor, with optional bounded follow polling.

commands.name: dev debug wait
commands.summary: Resume under a leased debugger session until a breakpoint hits or a timeout elapses.

commands.name: dev breakpoint list
commands.summary: List registered debug breakpoints and the current live debug status.

examples: sts2 --json dev breakpoint add --path screen.id --equals '"main-menu"' --name menu-break
sts2 --json dev breakpoint add --session dbg:1 --path combat.players[0].energy --kind change --min-hit-count 2 --auto-remove-on-hit
commands.name: dev breakpoint add
commands.summary: Register a live debug breakpoint with match/change kinds and the shared predicate grammar.

examples: sts2 --json dev breakpoint remove --session dbg:1 --id bp:1
commands.name: dev breakpoint remove
commands.summary: Remove a previously registered debug breakpoint by stable id.

commands.name: dev screenshot
commands.summary: Capture a bridge-backed PNG screenshot to a file.

commands.name: dev screenshot-diff
commands.summary: Compare a baseline PNG against either a live screenshot or an explicit actual PNG and optionally write a diff bundle.

commands.name: dev snapshot export
commands.summary: Capture one bounded snapshot-regression baseline bundle from the current runtime.

commands.name: dev snapshot compare
commands.summary: Compare a bounded snapshot spec against an exported baseline bundle and optionally write current evidence.

commands.name: dev visual-preflight
commands.summary: Run a bounded live visual preflight report with catalog explain, manifest-ready batch extraction, and artifact validation guidance.

commands.name: dev scene tree
commands.summary: Inspect the recursive live Godot runtime scene tree under an optional normalized /root path, with optional layout/render properties for calibration.

commands.name: dev scene node
commands.summary: Describe one exact live Godot runtime scene node and its direct children by normalized /root path, with opt-in developer properties including text-bearing label diagnostics.

commands.name: dev scene children
commands.summary: Inspect the direct children of one exact live Godot runtime scene node by normalized /root path.

commands.name: dev scene hover
commands.summary: Hover one live Godot Control by normalized /root path or current presentation element id and optionally return visible HoverTip text.

commands.name: dev scene unhover
commands.summary: Revert a prior dev scene hover: move the pointer to a neutral point to clear any active hover/tooltip and, when a target is given, invoke that live Godot Control's unfocus hook. Target is optional (omit for a global clear).

commands.name: dev scene set-visible
commands.summary: Set transient runtime visibility for one live Godot CanvasItem scene node by normalized /root path, with optional post-mutation stability verification.

commands.name: game detect
commands.summary: Report configured or detected game path status.

commands.name: game info
commands.summary: Describe the configured transport and bridge handshake state.

commands.name: game bridge-health
commands.summary: Diagnose live bridge readiness without mutating game files or processes.

commands.name: game install-bridge
commands.summary: Build and install only the bridge payload into the configured mods directory.

commands.name: game launch
commands.summary: Close any existing configured game process, then launch a fresh one.

commands.name: game mods settings
commands.summary: Read enabled and disabled mod ids from the saved STS2 mod settings file.

commands.name: game mods active
commands.summary: List mods reported by the live game through the bridge.

commands.name: game instances
commands.summary: List or prune named game instances (per-instance bridge socket + Godot user-dir; active instance may come from --instance, SPIRECTL_INSTANCE, or instances.default).

commands.name: game attach
commands.summary: Poll the configured Unix-socket bridge until live IPC attachment succeeds.

commands.name: game close
commands.summary: Gracefully stop the local game process through bridge, configured stop command, or exact platform process matching.

commands.name: game kill
commands.summary: Force terminate exact local game process matches.

commands.name: game deploy
commands.summary: Deploy the bridge plus a mod project, with optional build, restart, and verify.

commands.name: service serve
commands.summary: Run the CLI-owned HTTP/JSON automation service for remote metadata and bounded automation access.

commands.name: config resolve
commands.summary: Resolve config into absolute install paths (gamePath, assembliesDir, resourcesDir, modsDir, instancesDir, artifactsDir) with the source of each value, so scripts never re-parse sts2.local.yaml.

commands.name: toolchain info
commands.summary: Report managed toolchain roots, config provenance, and offline helper availability.

commands.name: project recover
commands.summary: Own stable repo-local offline recovery outputs and manifests under the managed toolchain root.

examples: sts2 project scaffold stable-harmony-trampoline --output ./mods/MyHotMod --mod-id my-hot-mod --name "My Hot Mod" --namespace MyHotMod
sts2 project scaffold stable-harmony-trampoline --output ./mods/MyHotMod --mod-id my-hot-mod --name "My Hot Mod" --namespace MyHotMod --enable-guardrails
sts2 --json project scaffold stable-harmony-trampoline --output ./mods/MyHotMod --mod-id my-hot-mod --name "My Hot Mod" --namespace MyHotMod --force-empty
commands.name: project scaffold stable-harmony-trampoline
commands.summary: Create a downstream stable Harmony trampoline hot-reload project with generated local profiles.

commands.name: project profile list
commands.summary: List checked-in profiles that may compose lifecycle and repo-local command steps.

commands.name: project profile show
commands.summary: Show one resolved checked-in profile with lifecycle and repo-local command steps.

commands.name: project profile run
commands.summary: Run one checked-in profile by composing lifecycle commands and repo-local command steps.

commands.name: project hook list
commands.summary: List registered repo-local validation hooks from the checked-in hooks file.

commands.name: project hook show
commands.summary: Show one registered repo-local validation hook with resolved command and cwd paths.

commands.name: project hook run
commands.summary: Run one registered repo-local validation hook through the JSON stdin/stdout contract.

commands.name: code locate
commands.summary: Locate types and methods in installed game or mod assemblies.

commands.name: code describe
commands.summary: Describe an exact type or method with structured metadata.

commands.name: code decompile
commands.summary: Show metadata-derived text by default, or ILSpy-backed output with --full.

commands.name: code refs
commands.summary: Find static references to an exact type or method, or do name-based fallback reference search.

commands.name: code derived
commands.summary: Find direct derived classes, implementers, and interface inheritance relationships for a type.

commands.name: code hooks
commands.summary: List static managed hook candidates with pagination, filters, script hints, and staged follow-up ids.

commands.name: code hook-info
commands.summary: Resolve one exact managed hook candidate into a hook-ready method signature projection.

commands.name: code scene-search
commands.summary: Search static Godot text, binary, and packed scenes, nodes, and resources without using the runtime bridge.

commands.name: code scene-tree
commands.summary: Show one exact static Godot scene tree from supported text, binary, or packed scene assets.

commands.name: code scene-node
commands.summary: Describe one exact static Godot scene node from supported text, binary, or packed scene assets, including NodePath and resource references.

examples: sts2 --json assets extract anim --execution live --format png --resources-dir ./game-project --game-path ~/games/sts2
sts2 --json assets extract model://characters/ironclad/iconOutline --execution live --format png
sts2 --json assets extract model://relics/burning-blood/bigIcon --execution live --format png
sts2 --json assets extract res://scenes/vfx/block_spark_vfx.tscn --execution live --format png
sts2 --json assets extract composed://combat-background/hive/image --execution live --format png
commands.name: assets extract
commands.summary: Search filesystem, packed, font, typed model-backed assets, and composed render targets, and export them with offline/live execution modes.

commands.name: assets catalog
commands.summary: List supported typed semantic asset key families and their model/composed provenance.

commands.name: models
commands.summary: Export immutable live game model metadata for a model family; localized text is returned as loc refs by default, or resolved with --language <code|auto>.

examples: sts2 --json reference colors aqua gold screenBackdrop
commands.name: reference
commands.summary: Export live game reference data that is constant at runtime but is not a game model. Built-in topics: colors (the StsColors palette) and version (game version, date, and modding summary). Topics are server-defined and extensible.

commands.name: assets resolve
commands.summary: Resolve one typed semantic asset key to its model/composed provider provenance.

commands.name: assets explain
commands.summary: Explain composed live asset decisions, expanded encounter package metadata, selector diagnostics, render diagnostics, isolation evidence, bounds, notices, and warnings without writing artifacts.

commands.name: assets extract-batch
commands.summary: Extract many filesystem, packed, or virtual model-backed assets from a generic JSON manifest while preserving per-request combat catalog notes, notices, provenance, failures, render diagnostics, and artifact-check diagnostics.

commands.name: skill install
commands.summary: Install the checked-in spirectl skill pack into a project-local .agents/skills directory or an explicit root path.

commands.name: completion
commands.summary: Generate shell completion text from the authoritative clap command tree.

commands.name: completion install
commands.summary: Install shell completion text into a spirectl-managed per-user path or an explicit file path and print activation metadata.

commands.name: inspect commands
commands.summary: List self-describing command metadata.

commands.name: inspect examples
commands.summary: List example invocations from the command catalog.

commands.name: inspect actions
commands.summary: Describe bridge-supported actions and current availability, with explicit --offline/mock paths for static metadata rendering without a live host.

commands.name: inspect state-schema
commands.summary: Describe the compact agent-first state schema, legacy migration path, and stable join rules.

commands.name: inspect reference-topics
commands.summary: List checked-in modding discovery and hot-reload workflow references, limits, and staged command sequences.

commands.name: inspect viewport-presets
commands.summary: List the effective viewport preset catalog available to visual capture commands.

commands.name: inspect ai-tools
commands.summary: Describe the thin AI adapter tool catalog mapped onto the CLI surface.

examples: sts2 --config tests/sts2.mock.yaml --json test run --failure-artifacts never tests/scenarios/smoke-main-menu.sts2.yaml
commands.name: test run
commands.summary: Execute YAML- or JSON-authored test scenarios with persisted summaries and failure artifacts.

commands.name: test stress
commands.summary: Repeat an existing scenario path under bounded iteration or duration controls and persist aggregate summaries.
